record.oneLiner: Cloud data platform with REST and SQL APIs that accept key pair JWT, OAuth, and programmatic access tokens, plus a Snowflake-managed MCP server.
record.verdictReason: Free access is a 30-day trial, after which a paid account is needed for continued API use. The vendor docs document OAuth, key pair JWT and PAT auth, and an official managed MCP server. apiType and apiBreadth evidence was not captured verbatim from fetched pages, so those values are unverified.
